records.claim: Gabapentin passes into breast milk in small amounts. While information is limited, reports of infants exposed to gabapentin through breast milk have not noted side effects. If you suspect the baby has any symptoms (such as drowsiness or trouble gaining weight), contact the child’s healthcare provider. Be sure to talk to your healthcare provider about all your breastfeeding questions. If a man takes gabapentin, could it affect fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
